newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Canadian firm wins Argentine mine tender.
newsitem.headline: Canadian firm wins Argentine mine tender.

text.p: Canada's Eastcan Mining Ltd was the only firm to improve its bid in an exploration tender by Argentina's Yacimientos Mineros Aguas de Dionisio (YMAD), an YMAD official said Thursday.
"They were the only firm to improve their offer. And for us it seems satisfactory, so they're practically certain to win the tender," YMAD board member Rodolfo Cecenarro told Reuters.
A formal announcement will probably be made in about a week, he said.
Eastcan doubled an earlier bid, Cecenarro said. The firm offered to pay YMAD $10.1 million on signing the deal, plus make a further $3 million in conditional payments.

Eastcan also said it would spend around $20 million in exploration at the site in the northwestern province of Catamarca. The firm would also pay 10 percent of profits of any eventual mine operation at the site until it had paid off its capital investment. After it had paid off its investment, it would pay YMAD 24 percent of profits.
YMAD said in November that it asked bidders in the tender for the 230 square km site to raise their offers.
